What to compare

Factor What to check Why it matters
Device limit Verify how many devices can stay connected at once Multipoint behavior varies by model
Switch trigger Test whether playback or a call moves the connection Automatic switching can interrupt another source
Codec fallback Check which codec each paired device negotiates A second connection can change latency or quality
Manual recovery Practice disconnecting and selecting the intended source Make pairing failures easier to recover from

Compare the tradeoffs

For bluetooth headphones for multipoint pairing, compare one change at a time. Start with device limit: verify how many devices can stay connected at once.
